output.summary: LT Verdict run is VALID but the deterministic verdict is NO_VERDICT with INCOMPLETE coverage. Business policy FAILed: overall error_rate_ratio in the run-intersection window was 2312/37841 ≈ 0.061, above the 0.01 threshold, with 2312/39099 ≈ 0.059 over all samples. All 2312 errors are recorded as frontend.request_error (service: frontend) and all occur on the checkout JMeter sampler (2312/6515 ≈ 35.5% of checkout samples), between 1790632254832 and 1790632369669 ms, peaking at 1300 errors/min around 1790632260000–1790632275000 ms; the other five samplers (add product to cart, cart, home, product, reset cart) report 0 errors. The only resource finding is a paymentservice cpu_throttle_ratio spike (observed_max 0.56895862409, observed_min 0.39467548476, threshold 0.2) at 1790632350000–1790632380000 ms, overlapping the tail of the error burst. The resource verdict is NO_VERDICT because paymentservice cpu/memory/throttle series are PARTIAL with MISSING_SAMPLES (4 of 23 expected cells missing, RESOURCE_GAPS) and the throttle policy check returned NO_VERDICT due to MISSING_RESOURCE_CELLS. Clock alignment between JMeter timestamps and metrics is not verified by the core, so temporal ordering between errors and resource data is unconfirmed.
